episodes.title: The Writing Process
episodes.description: Use the writing process to organize ideas and make writing projects less stressful.

episodes.title: Invention and the Writing Process
episodes.description: In this episode of Study Hall: Composition, Yumna talks us through Invention and the Writing Process of writing composition.

episodes.title: How to Plan Your Writing Project
episodes.description: In this episode of Study Hall: Composition, Yumna lays out the best ways to plan out your writing project.

episodes.title: What is Drafting
episodes.description: Explore drafting as a space for experimentation, learning from mistakes, and developing a piece of writing.

episodes.title: How to Revise
episodes.description: Learn when to reconsider cherished ideas during revision.

episodes.title: What is Editing
episodes.description: Explore editing as a final stage after larger revisions to a writing project.

episodes.title: Citations and Quotes
episodes.description: Learn how citations and quotations acknowledge other people’s ideas and words.

episodes.title: Critical Thinking and Arguing
episodes.description: Today, we’ll be talking about critical thinking and argumentation in writing, no shouting needed.

episodes.title: Evaluating Arguments
episodes.description: In evaluating the arguments of others, we’ll also get better at writing arguments ourselves.

episodes.title: What Is Rhetoric?
episodes.description: Explore rhetoric as a useful communication tool rather than simply empty or manipulative language.

episodes.title: Connecting With an Audience
episodes.description: Consider why writing sometimes misses its audience and how to communicate more effectively.

episodes.title: When and Where? Context Part 1
episodes.description: Timing and location are part of context, the factors that shape a particular situation.

episodes.title: Remediation! Context Part 2
episodes.description: Explore how writers create context that helps readers understand their message.

episodes.title: Purpose and Rhetorical Appeals
episodes.description: Understanding rhetorical appeals and how they affect the purpose of our writing is what we’re up to today in Study Hall: Composition.

episodes.title: Presentation and Persuasion in Writing
episodes.description: Examine persuasive choices in writing and learn to direct them more deliberately.
